prompt: There are $40$ students on the field trip. $\frac{3}{8}$ of them brought lunch from home. How many students did NOT bring lunch from home?
hint: Two steps: first find how many DID bring lunch, then subtract from $40$.

hints.text: Two steps: first find how many DID bring lunch, then subtract from $40$.
One eighth of $40$ is $40 \div 8 = 5$, so $\frac{3}{8}$ of $40$ is $3 \times 5 = 15$.

explanation: Step 1 — how many brought lunch: $\frac{3}{8} \times 40$. One eighth of $40$ is $40 \div 8 = 5$, so three eighths is $3 \times 5 = 15$ students.
Step 2 — the rest: $40 - 15 = 25$ students did not bring lunch from home.
So $25$ students will need a school lunch.

alternativeExplanations.title: Use the other fraction
steps: If $\frac{3}{8}$ brought lunch, then $\frac{5}{8}$ did not.
